actions.action: Tap a leaf over white paper to check for moving specks
Spray neem oil or insecticidal soap on leaves, undersides and soil surface every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Apply a soil drench or systemic insecticide if thrips persist
Move plant out of the window's brightest light in summer
Hang a sheer curtain on the window (alternative to moving the plant)
Slide plant out of pot and check roots and drainage
Check top 2-3 cm of soil before watering
Isolate the plant from other plants during treatment
Repot in fresh mix if damage or pests continue
